methodology: Coverage concerns declared checks, not every possible website defect.
Historical measurements are retained separately from current observations.
Structural validation and attributed review do not independently authenticate provider data.
No raw evidence payloads are included; inspect the source run using its recorded digest.
Redaction requires review; pattern matching is not a guarantee that every confidential value was identified.

narrative.text: Draft for the Atlas demonstration business. The supplied brief identifies a mixed lead-generation and booking site. Assessment at 2026-11-19T12:00:00Z covers the supplied evidence window from 11:00 UTC inclusive to 12:00 UTC exclusive, with a maximum capture age of 3,600 seconds. Sources are inputs/brief.md and the two original synthetic exports. The enterprise inventory setting is bounded sample because no site inventory is available. All three supplied files were reviewed.

One site entity and one directly captured URL, /services, are represented. /booking appears only as a canonical target and remains a discovery and target-verification candidate. Zero pages were fully audited. The captured URL remains pending for page-wide assessment. No captured URLs were excluded or unsupported. The failed browser attempt is separate from page counts and added no page evidence. Site-wide item totals and exclusions are unknown because discovery was unavailable.

The original inputs/collection-attempt.json records attempt-one by synthetic-export-1 for atlas-demo / website, synthetic environment, https://atlas.example/services, mobile and anonymous. It ran from 2026-11-19T11:35:00Z to 2026-11-19T11:36:00Z. Status unknown, gap browser-unavailable, synthetic true, executionAuthenticated false and semanticAcceptance false. This attempt yielded no capture. The standalone 11:30 UTC capture remains usable for its scoped semantic checks.

Ask website engineering to supply a fresh read-only canonical capture for the same URL, mobile profile and anonymous state. Preserve all three canonical layers, completeness, timestamps and original bytes. A later retry requires a new target window. Verify capture availability in that population and evaluate canonical semantics separately. Preserve attempt-one and its unknown availability in the original window.

The evidence leaves owner canonical intent, provider-selected canonical, index state, crawl permission, effective index controls, target eligibility, hreflang, structured data and the cause of the discrepancy unknown. The supplied head-layer summary provides no page body or claim sources for content quality, answer accuracy, or AI search readiness. No search surface was measured. Google AI Overviews and other AI answer surfaces remain unmeasured.

GA4 reporting and configuration, GTM, lead and booking outcome mapping, consent policy and runtime, field and lab performance, accessibility and journey outcomes remain unassessed. No live acquisition was performed. The exports are synthetic, and independent review remains pending.
